data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1598 (merged b5865bf6347).

Root cause was two stacked defects; the single-candidate case worked throughout, which is why canned-runner unit tests stayed green over the whole zero-findings window.

1. The batch entry contract inherited the single-pair model's all-defaulted fields and added candidate_id with a default too, so the emitted JSON Schema had NO required array at all. Live 6-candidate batches omitted confidence (defaulting to 0.0, below the 0.7 threshold, so aggregate could never surface anything) AND the model's multi-entry tool arguments degenerated outright, whole entries collapsing into the first string field. Proven not to be a token problem alone: with the output clamp removed entirely, batches were still malformed 3/3.
2. output_token_limit was a flat 1024 sized for one verdict, truncating any real batch; a truncated turn is rejected wholesale, abstaining every candidate.

Fix: candidate_id/relation/confidence/abstain are now required on the batch entry only (shared_artifact stays nullable, since a null there is a meaningful answer); the prompt restates rule 3 per entry; the output budget is now 256 + 192*n (1408 for a full 6-candidate batch), measured from real ~230-byte/~65-token entries. structured_retry_limit=0 and transport_attempt_limit=1 are untouched and now unit-asserted, so the 48k retry-storm class stays dead.

Live calibration before -> after (bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6): near-duplicate in a full batch went from all-6-abstain/confidence 0.0 to duplicates 0.95/0.95 surfaced; five distractors and an unrelated pair stay unsurfaced at 0.97-0.98. Recorded in docs/calibration/overlap_batch_confidence.md plus its committed output.

Deviation from plan: step 1's parenthetical suggested a prompt-side fix, but the prompt's confidence rule already survived batch rendering intact, so prompt-only would not have worked. The load-bearing fix was the contract's required fields, which required editing src/rebar/llm/contracts.py -- a file NOT in the recorded file_impact. Description plan content was not modified, so the plan-review attestation stayed valid.

Plan step 4 remains open: re-measure the surfaced-findings rate over the next N plan reviews now that the mechanism is provably working.
